steps.en: Run the one-line installer from the latest release on a Linux host with Docker
steps.zh: 在装了 Docker 的 Linux 主机上跑最新版的一行安装脚本

steps.en: Starts Core, Web, PostgreSQL and an HTTPS gateway; prints the console address and API base URL
steps.zh: 拉起 Core、Web、数据库和 HTTPS 网关，打印控制台和 API 地址

steps.en: In Web: set the domain, a default model and a Project API key, then add a node or E2B
steps.zh: 在 Web 里设域名、默认模型、项目密钥，再加节点或 E2B

steps.en: Point the official OpenAI SDK at your installation
steps.zh: 把官方 OpenAI SDK 指向你的安装

steps.en: Create a Session with a task and the harness you want (Codex, Claude Code, MiniMax Code)
steps.zh: 建一个会话，写明任务和要用的 harness

steps.en: Gets a sandbox, starts the Runtime daemon and runs the native harness in the workspace
steps.zh: 要一台沙箱，启动守护进程，在工作目录里跑原生 harness

component.zh: 守护进程与 harness 适配器

steps.en: Persists Turns, Items and events; your app reads or streams them through the same API
steps.zh: 持久化轮次、条目和事件，应用用同一套 API 读取或流式接收

value.en: Your app drives Codex, Claude Code or MiniMax Code via one OpenAI-shaped API on your machines — no per-agent glue, sandboxing or session store to build
value.zh: 一套 OpenAI 形状的 API 驱动三种编码 agent，不再自己搭沙箱和会话存储

sources: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore/blob/main/README.md Install section (curl -fsSL https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash; sign in to Web, configure domain and HTTPS, set a default model, issue a Project API key, add a node / E2B / own machine)

https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore/blob/main/docs/getting-started/install.md (installer loads Core, Web, PostgreSQL and HTTPS gateway images, starts them with Docker Compose, prints the console address and API base URL)

https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore/blob/main/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md (export OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://core.example/v1; session = client.beta.agents.sessions.create(...) with extra_body x_agents_core harness codex; poll turns and items)

https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore/blob/main/docs/architecture.md 'A Session, end to end' (Sandbox Provider obtains compute, Runtime prepares the workspace and runs the native Harness, Core persists output, tool interactions and receipts)
